products.title: Blonde Bison
products.body_html:
A timeless design inspired by the golden age of golf. 

Dark Sand & Blonde Bison

We custom-source our Cabretta leather from Pittards, the same leather house that produced the gloves of the British Royal Air Force during World War II. Scotch & Skins leathers are skillfully crafted with time-honored techniques that take no shortcuts, while integrating the latest stay-soft technology for a feel that’s second to none. 

Buttery-Soft Cabretta Leather 

Performance Moisture Control

Durable Craftsmanship

~~WHAT MAKES US PREMIUM~~

At Scotch & Skins, our Cabretta leather provides a buttery soft feel that remains supple even through extended use and sweat, thanks to a 200 year old tanning process. This exceptional quality leather, which costs more than 2x as much as regular leather, ensures our gloves last longer, delivering consistent comfort and performance round after round.

products.title: Sunburnt Gold Heritage Rope Hat
products.body_html:
Introducing the Heritage Collection Bison Design Rope Hat – the perfect blend of tradition and style for the discerning golfer. This exceptional hat, part of our exclusive Heritage Collection, features a meticulously crafted bison design that pays homage to the rugged beauty of the American plains.
Closure: Snapback
Water Repellent Fabric
Panels: 5
Sweatband: Cotton
Durable Canvas
Crown: High

Key Features:

  • Premium Quality: Made with high-quality materials, ensuring durability and comfort on and off the golf course.
  • Unique Design: The bison emblem is a symbol of strength and resilience, adding a touch of heritage to your golfing attire.
  • Adjustable Fit: Designed with an adjustable strap for a perfect fit, ensuring it stays secure during your swing.
  • Breathable Fabric: Keeps you cool and dry, even on the hottest days, thanks to its breathable and moisture-wicking fabric.
  • Versatile Style: Perfectly complements our range of golf gloves and accessories, making it a must-have addition to your golfing wardrobe.
